body: Eh, not a huge fan of this "corresponding state" business. We omit explicit states for referrer policy because it'd be annoying to sync cross-spec, and we omit any states at all for enterkeyhint and inputmode because I guess no other part of the processing model refers to it. But I think this would be better with the usual keyword/state split, including at least a simple table like https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-marquee-element:enumerated-attribute but maybe one with nice descriptions like https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-button-element:enumerated-attribute
